item.title: MYKOBO EURC Transitioning to Circle EURC
item.author: MYKOBO
item.content:encoded:
# MYKOBO EURC Transitioning to Circle EURC
4th of July 2024. Vilnius, Lithuania.
![image](https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/1012/1*vePnjaVnp2CJrOtxrimWdA.png)
MYKOBO recently announced [SEPA support for Euro deposits and withdrawals of the Circle EURC Stablecoin](https://medium.com/@myk0b0/sepa-rails-for-circles-eurc-on-stellar-0f0f07c71946) on the [Stellar blockchain](https://stellar.org/).
> Now, MYKOBO is excited to announce that the MYKOBO EURC Stablecoin issued on the Stellar blockchain will be transitioning to Circle EURC issued on the Stellar blockchain.
MYKOBO will transition over 25K [MYKOBO EURC](https://stellar.expert/explorer/public/asset/EURC-GAQRF3UGHBT6JYQZ7YSUYCIYWAF4T2SAA5237Q5LIQYJOHHFAWDXZ7NM) asset holders to [Circle EURC](https://stellar.expert/explorer/public/asset/EURC-GDHU6WRG4IEQXM5NZ4BMPKOXHW76MZM4Y2IEMFDVXBSDP6SJY4ITNPP2) asset holders on the Stellar blockchain. MYKOBO EURC asset holders bridged to the Polkadot blockchain via the [Pendulum Spacewalk bridge](https://pendulumchain.org/spacewalk) will also be transitioned to Circle EURC via the Spacewalk bridge.
![image](https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/1012/1*C1hK4u6RjaoAvPuTSx6uMw.png)
> MYKOBO will expand it’s services to provide support for Circle EURC across the Ethereum, Avalanche and Solana blockchains.
The MYKOBO on/off ramps and cross border payment services will be expanded to all the blockchains on which Circle EURC is currently issued.
![image](https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/1024/1*fXfrNgwK7KPI5GvLHnY5IQ.jpeg)
> Transitioning MYKOBO EURC to Circle EURC will allow MYKOBO to expand it’s services in line with the Markets in Crypto Assets Regulation (MiCAR) for an Electronic Money Token (EMT).
Circle has obtained the [necessary licenses](https://www.circle.com/en/pressroom/circle-is-first-global-stablecoin-issuer-to-comply-with-mica-eus-landmark-crypto-law) to make Circle EURC a MiCAR-compliant EMT.
Over the coming months, MYKOBO will be working with all our customers and partner platforms to transition MYKOBO EURC asset holders to Circle EURC asset holders.
All current MYKOBO services will continue to operate as normal during the transition phase with no disruptions.
**For more information, please contact us at: support@mykobo.co**
![image](https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/1024/1*X8X2Rj0kLrsihb9VHwr8wA.png)
[MYKOBO](https://mykobo.co/) provides a bridge connecting the European financial infrastructure to the blockchain using Euro Stablecoins that are pegged 1:1 with the Euro.
There are currently over 25K asset holders utilising the [EURC](https://stellar.expert/explorer/public/asset/EURC-GAQRF3UGHBT6JYQZ7YSUYCIYWAF4T2SAA5237Q5LIQYJOHHFAWDXZ7NM) Stablecoin on the Stellar blockchain through platforms such as [Clickpesa](https://clickpesa.com/), [Beans](https://www.beansapp.com/), [LOBSTR](https://lobstr.co/), [Pendulum](https://pendulumchain.org/), [xBull](https://xbull.app/), [LINK](https://www.linkio.world/), [Empowch](https://www.empowch.com/) and [Honeycoin](https://honeycoin.app/) in addition to the MYKOBO apps on [iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mykobo/id1491690533) and [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mykobo).
[Circle](https://www.circle.com/en/) has embraced a regulation-first approach in promoting the use of fully-reserved, fiat-backed digital currencies to empower businesses, promote financial inclusion, and drive fast, cost-effective global payments.
Circle issues EURC with over €35M in circulation and USDC with over $32B in circulation as of July 4, 2024.

item.title: SEPA Rails for Circle’s EURC on Stellar
item.author: MYKOBO
item.content:encoded:
# SEPA Rails for Circle’s EURC on Stellar
![](https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/1024/1*pfDJwj79Tr5VxAWDaAWoKA.png)
[MYKOBO](https://mykobo.co/) is thrilled to announce support for Euro deposits and withdrawals of Circle’s euro-backed stablecoin, EURC, on the Stellar blockchain
**What does this new service mean for users?**
This means that European users with Stellar wallets will be able to make Euro deposits and withdrawals with Circle’s EURC using the Single Euro Payments Area (SEPA) network.
**Where can users access this service?**
This exciting new service is now accessible via the [LOBSTR](https://lobstr.co/) wallet, renowned for its simplicity and security, and widely used on the Stellar blockchain.
[Click here](https://lobstr.co/deposit/EURC:GDHU6WRG4IEQXM5NZ4BMPKOXHW76MZM4Y2IEMFDVXBSDP6SJY4ITNPP2/) to start a EUR deposit with EURC
[Click here](https://lobstr.co/withdraw/EURC:GDHU6WRG4IEQXM5NZ4BMPKOXHW76MZM4Y2IEMFDVXBSDP6SJY4ITNPP2/) to start a EUR withdrawal with EURC
Or download the LOBSTR [iOS](https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/lobstr-stellar-wallet/id1404357892?mt=8) or[Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.lobstr.client) app today to start your EURC journey.
![](https://cdn-images-1.medium.com/max/1024/1*YlPW0S7xI7enhaZF_UKWjw.jpeg)
**Why support Circle’s EURC Stablecoin?**
MYKOBO believes in the potential of Circle’s EURC as the leading Euro stablecoin for crypto capital markets, EURC is fully reserved so that it’s always redeemable 1:1 for Euro.
Circle’s EURC Stablecoin is currently issued on the Ethereum, Solana, Avalanche and Stellar blockchains.
MYKOBO believes users will benefit from the trust, transparency, and security of Circle as the issuer of the USDC stablecoin with over $31B in circulation as of March 2024.
**What does this mean for MYKOBO’s EURC Stablecoin?**
MYKOBO will continue to provide full support for the MYKOBO EURC Stablecoin as the partnership with Circle continues expanding with the objective of building a trusted and interoperable Euro Stablecoin.
**What is MYKOBO?**
MYKOBO provides a bridge connecting the European financial infrastructure to the blockchain using Euro Stablecoins that are pegged 1:1 with the Euro.
There are currently over 20K users utilizing the [EURC](https://stellar.expert/explorer/public/asset/EURC-GAQRF3UGHBT6JYQZ7YSUYCIYWAF4T2SAA5237Q5LIQYJOHHFAWDXZ7NM) Stablecoin on the Stellar blockchain through platforms such as [Beans](https://www.beansapp.com/), [LOBSTR](https://lobstr.co/), [xBull](https://xbull.app/), [LINK](https://www.linkio.africa/), [Empowch](https://www.empowch.com/) and [Honeycoin](https://honeycoin.app/) in addition to the MYKOBO apps on [iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mykobo/id1491690533) and [Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mykobo).
**What is Stellar?**
Stellar is a blockchain where blockchain technology meets the real world by providing real world utility with solutions like the disbursement of aid or cheaper and faster cross border payments.
**What is SEPA?**
The SEPA network allows users to send and receive cashless Euro bank payments via transfer and direct debit to anywhere in the European Union (EU), as well as a number of non-EU countries.

item.title: AMA March Recap With CEO & Co-Founder: Seyi Akin-Olugbemi
item.author: MYKOBO
item.content:encoded:
# AMA March Recap With CEO & Co-Founder: Seyi Akin-Olugbemi
#### **Q. Who is Seyi?**
I am a hacker at heart. I enjoy building things and watching them come to life.
I studied Mathematics and Software Engineering and have 10 years of experience in the Fintech space working in payments, banking and microfinance.
I worked for 16 years in technology starting with tech support and ending up as the IT Director for Technology and Infrastructure with the Richemont Group.
Today, I run MYKOBO, the EURC Stablecoin issuer providing a bridge connecting European consumers and businesses to the blockchain using Stellar.
#### **Q. What does MYKOBO mean?**
The “kobo” is the smallest unit of the Nigerian currency, similar to the way the cent is the smallest unit of the USD or indeed the EUR currency.
*MYKOBO means MYCOIN.*
#### **Q. What motivated you to start MYKOBO and a Euro stablecoin.**
MYKOBO was born one fateful day when Kwabena (CTO) and I got into a passionate discussion about sending money to Nigeria and Ghana.
We went deep, touching on topics like financial inclusion and blockchain technology and knew instantly we had to build what we were trying to articulate.
#### **Q. Why Stellar?**
Stellar is built at a protocol level to support the storage and movement of money i.e “value”.
This is exactly why we started MYKOBO so Stellar was a natural fit.
Stellar also has a great community and support structure for companies building on Stellar.
#### **Q. What is EURC?**
The EURo Coin (EURC) is an asset-backed stablecoin pegged 1:1, issued by MYKOBO UAB and built on Stellar.
#### **Q. What coins are supported on MYKOBO?**
Currently, within the MYKOBO app, we support the holding of the following coins: EURC, USDC, XLM and AQUA.
#### **Q. Can I hold coins from other networks?**
At present, all of the supported coins are connected to the Stellar blockchain network.
It is not possible to hold other coins from other networks in the app.
#### **Q. What Liquidity Pools are available?**
Pairs that are supported by MYKOBO in our app are: — XLM/EURC — EURC/USDC (coming soon) — AQUA/EURC (coming soon)
#### **Q. Does Circle manage the treasury?**
Circle do not manage our treasury. They are a partner that enables us to use their infrastructure for USDC.
MYKOBO is building the most active fiat-backed Euro stablecoin [EURC](https://twitter.com/search?q=%24EURC&src=cashtag_click) on [Stellar](https://twitter.com/StellarOrg).
**MYKOBO** issues the EURC stablecoin pegged 1:1 with the Euro, providing a bridge connecting the European financial infrastructure to the blockchain using Stellar.
For more information on MYKOBO and EURC visit the [MYKOBO website](https://www.mykobo.co/).
